hooks.text: 梦疫会随停留时间不断增强，守不住时可带着整座城市直接起飞撤离。
hooks.excerpt: Fortify your city and defend it against raids for as long as you can. But even the ancients were unable to withstand the Dream Plagues forever - the longer you stay, the stronger they become. Unlike the ancients, however, you are able to grab your entire city and just fly away when things become too rough.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 飞城面积有限，必须权衡永久扩建与注定留在旧地图的一次性基础设施。
hooks.excerpt: Your city’s area is limited. You’ll have to balance between expensive long-term upgrades to expand your city, and building disposable infrastructure that will be left behind . Carefully choose which buildings you take with you and which you can live without - at least for a while.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 离开城市后直接操控可升级的蒸汽机器人，以实时动作探索荒野并适配个人打法。
hooks.excerpt: To explore your surroundings, you directly control a unique Steam-Bot in real time action . You will upgrade, equip and customize that Steam-Bot to your preferred play style.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
